visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair wearing a light grey short-sleeved button-down shirt stands in a modern, brightly lit office hallway. He holds a dark grey, circular headphone case with a small black loop, looking at it with a soft smile. (2) The scene shifts to the man sitting on a white plush sofa in a well-lit indoor living room. He holds the headphone case with both hands and begins to open it. (3) A close-up shot features a pair of dark blue/grey over-ear headphones held against a dark background where camera lenses are visible. The 'SONY' logo is engraved on the metal hinge. (4) The camera focuses on the interior of the headphone case, which is light grey with a dedicated compartment for a cable. The headphones are folded and tucked inside. (5) Back to the man on the sofa, talking while holding the case. The background features warm indoor lighting and decorative curtains. (6) A macro close-up shows the headphone hinge mechanism rotating. The matte finish and metallic 'SONY' branding are clearly visible under studio lights. (7) The man is seen from the chest up as he puts the headphones over his ears and then lowers them to rest around his neck. (8) A comparison shot shows the man wearing a different, light-tan pair of headphones (XM5) around his neck; he points at them with a slightly dissatisfied facial expression. (9) Close-up detail of the XM6 hinge folding smoothly, demonstrating the compact design. (10) The camera zooms in on the controls of the headphone cup, showing a large circular power button, a USB-C port, and an NC/AMB button. (11) A side-by-side comparison displays the XM5 controls (top) with smaller buttons and the XM6 controls (bottom) with a significantly larger power button. (12) The man continues his discussion on the sofa, wearing the headphones and gesturing with open palms for emphasis. (13) A profile shot shows him wearing the headphones in a bright indoor setting with glass partitions. (14) The man removes the headphones and holds them toward the camera while concluding his talk on the sofa.
